issue.body:
The `authentication.requires` doesn't work with handler methods defined in a class-based endpoint. 

I don't know if there's another way, currently, to declaratively annotate required scopes per-method for a class-based endpoint. If not, there should be another decorator(e.g. `method_requires`) that can be used with methods. 

Thanks!
issue.title: Decorator for validating required scopes per-method in class-based endpoints
